skills.description: This skill should be used when a user uploads a soil photo and asks for soil health analysis, composition diagnosis, or soil restoration recommendations. It analyzes the image against the standard four-phase soil model (mineral 45% / air 20-30% / water 20-30% / organic matter 5%), produces a 0-100 health score, identifies the imbalance type (compaction / salinization / depletion / continuous-cropping fatigue), and outputs a restoration plan based on the photosynthetic-microbial ecological soil (光合宏菌群生态土) framework tied to Kunyuan Lvke (坤元绿科) product line (Changfeng bacteria + photosynthetic bacteria combinations). Triggers include phrases like "看看这片土" "土壤诊断" "土质怎么样" "土壤修复" "生态土" "光合菌" plus an attached image.
